questions.answer: (1) The sport which he enjoys most is soccer. (2) This is the girl whom I met at the library.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(1) The sport is soccer. He enjoys it most. → The sport __________________________________________.

(2) This is the girl. I met her at the library. → This is _________________________________ at the library.
questions.explanation: (1) 사물 the sport를 수식하는 that/which를 사용합니다. (2) 사람 the girl을 수식하는 whom/who/that을 사용합니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) The sport that he enjoys most is soccer. (2) This is the girl that I met at the library. / This is the girl who I met at the library.

questions.answer: (1) Did you watch the movie which they showed in class? (2) The package which I ordered three days ago hasn't come yet.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(1) They showed a movie in class. Did you watch it? → Did you watch _____________________________________?

(2) The package hasn't come yet. I ordered it three days ago. → The package _________________________________________.
questions.explanation: 각각 사물 the movie, the package를 선행사로 하는 목적격 관계대명사 that/which를 사용해 연결합니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) Did you watch the movie that they showed in class? (2) The package that I ordered three days ago hasn't come yet.

questions.answer: (1) The bread which Kevin baked is very fresh. (2) I know the man whom Lisa talked with yesterday.
questions.question:
다음 <보기>와 같이 주어진 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만드시오. (단, that은 사용하지 말 것) ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

<보기>
This is the song. I told you about it. → This is the song which I told you about.

(1) The bread is very fresh. Kevin baked it. → ______________________________________________________

(2) I know the man. Lisa talked with him yesterday. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: (1) 사물 the bread를 수식하는 which를 씁니다. (2) 사람 the man을 수식하며 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 whom을 사용합니다.
acceptedAnswers: (2) I know the man with whom Lisa talked yesterday.
(2) I know the man who Lisa talked with yesterday.

questions.answer: (1) Show me the photo which was drawn by Jina. (2) Did you read the message which you wrote this morning?
questions.question:
다음 <보기>와 같이 관계대명사를 사용하여 주어진 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

<보기> She has a cat. It has blue eyes. → She has a cat which has blue eyes.

(1) Show me the photo. It was drawn by Jina. → ______________________________________________________

(2) Did you read the message? You wrote it this morning. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: (1) 주격 관계대명사 which를 사용합니다. (2) 목적격 관계대명사 which/that을 사용해 the message를 수식합니다.
acceptedAnswers: (2) Did you read the message that you wrote this morning?
(1) Show me the photo that was drawn by Jina. (2) Did you read the message that you wrote this morning?

questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 빈칸 (1), (2)에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 <조건>에 맞게 완성하시오.

This is the watch below. (Mike의 질문)
Mike: What a cool watch! Where did you get it?
Amy: I won a math quiz last month. It's a prize of the quiz.
Mike: Wow, I didn't know that you are good at math.
Amy: I love it a lot. Solving math problems is fun.

<조건> 반드시 관계대명사를 포함할 것 (단, that은 사용하지 말 것)

(1) There is the watch ______________________ a prize of the math quiz.
(2) Amy is a girl ___________________ solving math problems.
questions.explanation: (1) 사물 the watch를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 which와 be동사 is를 씁니다. (2) 사람 a girl을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 who와 동사 likes를 씁니다.

questions.answer: This is the temple which people built in the 8th century.
questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 (a)와 (b)를 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(a) This is the temple. (b) People built it in the 8th century.
questions.explanation: 사물 선행사(the temple)의 목적격 관계대명사이므로 which[that]를 쓰거나 생략할 수 있다.
acceptedAnswers: This is the temple that people built in the 8th century.
This is the temple people built in the 8th century.

questions.answer: (1) David found the umbrella which I lost yesterday. (2) The cake which my aunt baked for us was very sweet.
questions.question:
다음 <보기>와 같이 주어진 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

<보기>
The teacher was very friendly. I met a teacher at the camp.
→ The teacher whom I met at the camp was very friendly.

(1) David found the umbrella. I lost the umbrella yesterday.
⟶ David _____________________________________________.

(2) My aunt baked a cake for us. The cake was very sweet.
⟶ The cake _______________________________________.
questions.explanation: (1) 사물 the umbrella를 수식하는 목적격 관계대명사 which/that을 사용합니다. (2) the cake를 수식하는 목적격 관계대명사 which/that을 사용해 주어를 만듭니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) David found the umbrella that I lost yesterday. (2) The cake that my aunt baked for us was very sweet.

questions.answer: (1) That is the man whom I saw at the bus stop this morning. / (2) Daniel is the friend whom I count on in hard times. / (3) Is this the pen which you are searching for?
questions.question:
다음 <보기>와 같이 관계대명사를 사용하여 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

<보기>
This is the book. I borrowed it from the library.
→ This is the book which I borrowed from the library.

(1) That is the man. I saw him at the bus stop this morning. → ______________________________________________________

(2) Daniel is the friend. I count on him in hard times. → ______________________________________________________

(3) Is this the pen? You are searching for it. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: 사람이 목적어이면 whom, 사물이 목적어이면 which를 씁니다. (1)은 him이 목적어이므로 whom, (2)는 him이 목적어이므로 whom, (3)은 it이 목적어이므로 which를 사용합니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) That is the man that I saw at the bus stop this morning. / (2) Daniel is the friend that I count on in hard times.
(1) That is the man who I saw at the bus stop this morning. / (2) Daniel is the friend who I count on in hard times.

questions.answer: is the girl who fell in love with the prince.
questions.question:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 관계대명사와 주어진 단어를 사용하여 영작하시오. (Cinderella 제외 10단어)

Cinderella는 왕자와 사랑에 빠진 그 소녀입니다. (fell)

→ Cinderella _______________________________________________.
questions.explanation: 선행사가 사람(the girl)이고 관계대명사절 안에서 주어 역할을 하므로 주격 관계대명사 who를 씁니다. 'fall in love with'는 '~와 사랑에 빠지다'라는 뜻입니다.

questions.answer: (1) I enjoy the soup which my grandma cooks. / (2) Sora is holding the umbrella which her brother lent to her. / (3) The posters which you designed are on the door.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 관계대명사 whom 혹은 which를 사용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(1) I enjoy the soup. My grandma cooks it. → ______________________________________________________

(2) Sora is holding the umbrella. Her brother lent it to her. → ______________________________________________________

(3) The posters are on the door. You designed them. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: 세 문장 모두 선행사가 사물이므로 목적격 관계대명사 which를 사용합니다. 관계대명사절 안에서 목적어(it, them)가 관계대명사로 바뀌면서 그 자리는 비워둡니다.

questions.answer: (1) This is the poster (which) our team drew. / (2) The girl who wears a cap is watering the plants.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 관계대명사(that 제외)를 사용하여 한 문장으로 만들고 생략이 가능한 관계대명사를 괄호로 묶으시오. ※ 예: This is the pen (which) I bought.

(1) This is the poster. Our team drew the poster. → ______________________________________________________

(2) The girl is watering the plants. She wears a cap. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: (1)은 목적격 관계대명사이므로 which를 쓰고 생략 가능하여 괄호로 묶습니다. (2)는 주격 관계대명사 who이며 주격은 생략할 수 없습니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) This is the poster which our team drew. / (2) The girl who wears a cap is watering the plants.
(1) This is the poster our team drew. / (2) The girl who wears a cap is watering the plants.

questions.answer: (1) This is an app which we use in projects. / (2) Sam, who I hoped to visit, was not home.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 who, which, that 중에서 한 개를 활용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(1) This is a app. We use it in projects. → ______________________________________________________

(2) Sam was not home. I hoped to visit him. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: (1)은 사물이 목적어이므로 which나 that을 씁니다. (2)는 사람이 목적어이므로 whom(또는 that)을 쓰며, 고유명사 Sam은 콤마를 사용하여 삽입합니다.
acceptedAnswers: This is an app that we use in projects.
Sam, whom I hoped to visit, was not home.

questions.answer: (1) My sister loves the poem which I used to recite. / (2) I have a cat which my aunt gave me for my graduation gift. / (3) He noticed a woman whom I was chatting with at the café.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(1) My sister loves the poem. I used to recite the poem. → ______________________________________________________

(2) I have a cat. My aunt gave me the cat for my graduation gift. → ______________________________________________________

(3) He noticed a woman. I was chatting with the woman at the café. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: (1)(2)는 사물이 목적어이므로 which를 씁니다. (3)은 사람이 목적어이며 전치사 with의 목적어이므로 whom을 쓰고, 전치사를 앞으로 보낼 수도 있습니다.
acceptedAnswers: My sister loves the poem that I used to recite.
He noticed a woman with whom I was chatting at the café.
He noticed a woman who I was chatting with at the café.

questions.answer: (1) This is the same bag that I saw at the market. / (2) The man who I met at the bank is my uncle.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(1) This is (at / bag / I / saw / that / the / market / the / same). → ______________________________________________________

(2) The man (I / bank / at / met / the / who) is my uncle. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: (1) 'the same' 뒤에는 주로 that을 쓰며 목적격 관계대명사절이 이어집니다. (2) 선행사 The man 뒤에 who가 이끄는 관계대명사절이 삽입됩니다.

questions.answer: (1) • I gave Tom the ticket. • I paid ten dollars for it. / (2) • The coat suits me well. • My dad bought it for me.
questions.question:
다음 <보기>와 같이 (1), (2)에 주어진 문장을 두 개의 완전한 문장으로 나누어 쓰시오.

<보기>
She has a cat which has blue eyes. → • She has a cat. • It has blue eyes.

(1) I gave Tom the ticket for which I paid ten dollars. → • ____________________________________________________
• ____________________________________________________

(2) The coat which my dad bought for me suits me well. → • ____________________________________________________
• ____________________________________________________
questions.explanation: 관계대명사절을 원래의 두 문장으로 되돌리는 문제입니다. 관계대명사가 대신하던 명사를 대명사(it)로 바꾸어 두 번째 문장을 완성합니다.

questions.answer: (1) The bread which French people eat is soft. / (2) This is the dress which I will wear at my son's wedding.
questions.question:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 두 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(1) The bread is soft. French people eat it.
(프랑스 사람들이 먹는 그 빵은 부드럽다.) → ______________________________________________________

(2) This is the dress. I will wear it at my son's wedding.
(이것은 내 아들의 결혼식 때 입을 드레스이다.) → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: 두 문장 모두 사물이 목적어이므로 목적격 관계대명사 which(또는 that)를 씁니다. (1)은 주어를 수식하는 관계대명사절이 문장 중간에 삽입됩니다.
acceptedAnswers: The bread that French people eat is soft.
This is the dress that I will wear at my son's wedding.

questions.answer: (1) Charlotte's Web is the book that I read last week. / (2) The soup that my dad made was very tasty. / (3) Mina and Jina are the guests that we invited last night.
questions.question:
다음 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 어법에 맞게 문장을 완성하시오. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

(1) (the / Charlotte's Web / is / I / read / last week / book / that). → ______________________________________________________

(2) (my dad / was / that / very / the / tasty / soup / made). → ______________________________________________________

(3) (we / are / Mina and Jina / invited / that / last night / the guests). → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: 관계대명사 that이 이끄는 목적격 관계대명사절이 선행사(book, soup, guests)를 수식하도록 배열합니다. (2)는 주어를 수식하므로 동사 was가 뒤에 옵니다.

questions.answer: (1) She is the dancer whom we watched at the School Concert last month. / (2) She performed a dance which everyone at the concert loved most.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 밑줄 친 문장 ⓐ, ⓑ를 관계대명사를 사용하여 각각 한 문장으로 만드시오.(단, 관계대명사를 생략하지 말 것) ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

A: I saw Emma Wilson this morning.
B: Emma Wilson?
A: Yes, ⓐshe is the dancer. We watched her at the School Concert last month.
B: Right. ⓑShe performed a dance. Everyone at the concert loved the dance most.

(1) 문장 ⓐ를 관계대명사로 연결하여 쓰시오. → ______________________________________________________

(2) 문장 ⓑ를 관계대명사로 연결하여 쓰시오. → ______________________________________________________
questions.explanation: (1)은 사람(the dancer)이 목적어이므로 whom을 씁니다. (2)는 사물(a dance)이 목적어이므로 which를 쓰며, 문제 조건에 따라 관계대명사를 생략하지 않습니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) She is the dancer that we watched at the School Concert last month. / (2) She performed a dance that everyone at the concert enjoyed.
(1) She is the dancer who we watched at the School Concert last month. / (2) She performed a dance which everyone at the concert enjoyed.

questions.answer: (1) who wears a mask is Junho. / (2) who has curly hair is Somi.
questions.question:
다음 준호와 소미를 모르는 친구에게 설명하고자 한다. 두 학생을 묘사하는 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 완성하시오.

<조건>
1. 준호는 남학생, 소미는 여학생으로 할 것
2. 'curly hair', 'a mask' 표현을 포함할 것
3. 각 문장에 주격 관계대명사를 반드시 포함할 것

(1) The boy ___________________________________ Junho.
(2) The girl ______________________________________ Somi.
questions.explanation: 선행사가 사람이고 관계대명사절 안에서 주어 역할을 하므로 주격 관계대명사 who를 씁니다. wear(착용하다), have(가지고 있다) 동사와 함께 특징을 묘사합니다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) who has curly hair is Junho. / (2) who wears a mask is Somi.
